data.headline: Cadence and Siemens climb, TSM rallies: Trending Tickers
data.summary: Cadence Design Systems (CDNS) and Synopsys (SNPS) shares rose after the US Commerce Department eased export restrictions, allowing them to resume business with clients in China. Siemens (SIE.DE) stock climbed after the company confirmed it restored full access to software and resumed sales to Chinese customers. Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company (TSM) gained after analysts raised their price target and a Reuters report that Intel (INTC) is exploring scaling back efforts to compete in advanced chip manufacturing.
